plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps liability at one month of Fees 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2/21.3; fix cap size and preserve carve-outs.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-side indemnity (20.1) and a dangling cross-reference to Section 20.5; Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears absent and must be added, with Customer indemnity narrowed.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month worldwide non-compete on Customer — delete; 12.3 already confirms Customer's freedom and supports removal.
Sec 2.2 makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics; strike as inconsistent with 12.3.
No MFN obligation on Customer found; 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm pricing sections carry no hidden best-terms duty.
No non-solicit binding Customer; 12.3 preserves hiring via general recruitment. Verify no no-hire term hides in Order Form/personnel provisions.
Sec 9.4 already gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and no Vendor equivalent; check interaction with the take-or-pay in 2.1 which would defeat it.
Sec 8.2 (30-day non-renewal notice plus reminder) and 8.3 (CPI/3% cap) largely meet the playbook; confirm no uncapped uplift or longer notice elsewhere.
New York law and New York County courts are on the accepted list; no arbitration clause — verify only, likely no change.
24.1–24.4 permit Customer affiliate/successor assignment and bar Vendor termination on our change of control; confirm 24.3 catch-all does not cut back 24.1.
Ownership of Customer Data and Deliverables sits with Customer; check the definitions of Deliverable/Vendor Technology and 15.1 model-training limits for leakage.
Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, excluding Affiliates and contractors — must be revised to align with 13.2/13.3.
22.1–22.3 already provide annual, 30-day notice, off-site, Vendor-cost audits; confirm Section 23 records/assurance adds no separate audit burden on us.
No express liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer; the take-or-pay in 2.1 and any interest/penalty language on disputed sums are the closest analogues to check.
Sec 19.2 limits the Deliverable warranty to 15 days and bars any later remedy — extend the period and preserve the 19.4 remedy.
Insurance program present with cyber, E&O, CGL and no-limitation language; verify limits meet playbook thresholds.
Sec 2.1 imposes a USD 2M/year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination rights — delete or subject to the 9.4 convenience-termination right.
Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export, contradicting 11.2/11.3 — strike 11.1 and add a transition-assistance period.
